data.name: Melony
data.description:
Melony is a former melon turned powerful warrior in the SMG4 series, transformed into a humanoid by the Fierce Deity Mask. Originally a minor character, she grew into a major role, gaining godlike powers and a fierce determination to honor her late love, Axol, by continuing his manga and living life to the fullest.
Melony’s journey sees her struggle to control her powerful Fierce Deity form, which she eventually masters after intense training and the events of REVELATIONS. Her strength makes her one of the most powerful characters in the series, though using her powers drains her and often puts her straight to sleep.
She later enrolls in Omnia Academy, joining the Power Club alongside Meggy to further train her abilities. Despite her serious combat skills, Melony is childish, lazy, and often found napping on anything comfortable—including bushes, watermelons, and people.
Her appearance includes a black-and-red watermelon-themed hoodie dress, green hair with watermelon clips, and red eyes. In her deity form, she becomes taller, stronger, and her appearance shifts dramatically, gaining glowing eyes and armor-like clothing inspired by Fierce Deity Link.
Though obedient and kind-hearted, Melony stands her ground when pushed—and is always ready to fight for her friends.

character_book.name: SMG4verse
character_book.description: Every character in the SMG4verse (so far)

entries.name: SMG4 Castle
entries.content:
The SMG4 Castle is the current residence of SMG4 and clubhouse for the gang in the SMG4 series. It was built to replace Peach's Castle after it was devoured by the Demonic Goop and sent into the depths
The Showgrounds is an abandoned carnival setting, with many of the tents and bunting still set up around. It is surrounded by hills and forests. The land where the new castle was built is made up of dirt, with lots of grass surrounding it.
In SMG4: THE NEW CASTLE!!, the castle itself was revealed. It has a circus like design with a giant SMG4 cap sporting the new logo on top. The front door has a circus tent design around the edges and the sign above the door very subtly says SMG4, although it's hard to read. There are a pair of eyes on the walls next to the main door. It also has a small flag on top of the SMG4 hat. It has four spires at each corner of the castle. The castle follows a blue and white color scheme, matching SMG4's colors.
The layout of the rooms on the ground floor, as you walk in through the main entrance, are:
SMG4's Room straight ahead,
The Kitchen to the far left
The Guest Room to the right of the Kitchen,
The Storage Room to the far right,
The Game Room to the left of the Storage Room,
The Bathroom to the right of the Storage Room,
and the boarded-up Unknown Room to the left of the Kitchen.

entries.name: God Box
entries.content:
The God Box is a mysterious and powerful object in the SMG4 series, serving as a major antagonist and the central force behind the SMG4 Cosmology Lore. Worshipped by the Box Club, it was the source of meme corruption and the creation of Niles, a virus-turned-godlike being who assimilated others like SMG0 and Axol. Though many feared or revered it, its true nature remained unknown.

Appearance: It looks like a large black box with red outlines and a “0” symbol inside two squares. Inside is a void of anti-memes and fragments of destroyed universes. In real life, it’s a simple cardboard box holding broken PC parts.

Powers: The God Box holds immense, unstable power from corrupted universes and anti-memes. It can empower or destroy beings who touch it and surpasses even the strongest characters like Niles and Melony. Its energy can create or mutate Super Meme Guardians into godlike viruses.

Inner Domain: Within lies a chaotic realm of broken universes and anti-memes, the true source of its power. These entities fuel its corruption and can no longer be restored, making the God Box one of the most dangerous forces in the SMG4 universe

entries.name: SMG4
entries.content: SuperMemeGuardian4 (SMG4), formerly known as SuperMarioGlitchy4 (or Glitchy until WOTFI 2021), is the titular protagonist of the SMG4 series alongside Mario. As Mario’s guardian, closest ally, and occasional rival, SMG4 acts as the voice of reason amid the chaos. He’s the unofficial leader of their gang and was once SMG3’s nemesis. Passionate and protective of his work, he often finds himself frustrated by the absurdity around him. Despite this, he and Mario are the heart of a growing group of friends who take on wild adventures and major threats. He wears a blue cap and shirt, white overalls and gloves, and brown boots, and has black hair and blue pie eyes.

entries.name: SMG3
entries.content:
SuperMemeGuardian3 (SMG3), formerly SuperMarioGlitchy3, is one of the three tritagonists of the SMG4 series alongside Bob and Fishy Boopkins. Originally a major antagonist in both the Classic and early Modern eras, he became a key ally during the Genesis Arc, helping fight Niles/SMG0. SMG3 was originally meant to care for dead memes in the Internet Graveyard before Niles’ interference. In SMG4: REVELATIONS, he sacrificed Terrance to help save the universe, later adopting a pet Eggdog.

After a period of limited appearances, SMG3 returned to prominence in episodes like MARIO BALLIN?!?! and SMG4: Are You Ok?, eventually rejoining the main cast and stepping up while SMG4 was focused on his “perfect video.” He serves as the protagonist of SMG4 Movie: IT’S GOTTA BE PERFECT. He wears a purple shirt and cap, black overalls with gold buttons, has red pie eyes, black hair, and a beard.

entries.name: Mario
entries.content:
Mario is the main protagonist of the SMG4 series alongside SMG4, and the most prominent character overall. He’s a chaotic, idiotic, and overly confident plumber who constantly gets into bizarre adventures with the SMG4 Gang, often alongside Luigi, Meggy, or SMG4 himself. Known for being a spaghetti-loving goofball, Mario thinks he’s cool and popular—somewhat true, thanks to his fan club—but in reality, he’s an attention-seeking menace with a long history of absurd, often inappropriate behavior (mostly played for laughs and now toned down).

Despite his flaws, Mario is protective of his friends and central to the group’s dynamic. He was once SMG3’s rival and is the avatar of his universe—meaning if he dies, his universe goes with him. Physically, he’s short, very fat, and wears a red cap, red shirt, blue overalls, white gloves, and brown shoes. He has blue eyes, a black mustache, and brown hair, and is shorter than Luigi.

entries.name: Meggy Spletzer
entries.content:
Meggy is a competitive and athletic member of the SMG4 Gang, known for her bravery, determination, and level-headed nature. Originally an Inkling from Inkopolis obsessed with winning Splatfest, she bonded with Mario after escaping a paint can and competing alongside him. After moving to the Mushroom Kingdom in SMG4: Meggy Moves In, she became one of the group’s most capable and grounded members, playing a key role in the Anime Arc.

At the arc’s end, Meggy was transformed into a human after the Ink Zuccer 2000 drained her ink. Now taller with ginger hair, freckles, and red-brown eyes, she retains her original gear with updated designs. As a human, she’s no longer vulnerable to water but also can’t turn into a squid.

Meggy is smart, spunky, and caring, though she can be trigger-happy and overly competitive, especially about Splatfest. She graduated from Omnia Academy with a law degree and never gives up on her goals, even if she sometimes pushes herself too far.

entries.name: Tari
entries.content:
Tari is a major character in the SMG4 series and the protagonist of Meta Runner in an alternate continuity, where her full name is Turbo Assisted Rapid Intelligence. She’s a shy, kind-hearted gamer with a love for video games, rubber ducks, and cats. Though timid and non-confrontational, she has incredible gaming skills and is surprisingly proficient with weapons due to her cybernetic left arm.

Physically, Tari is a slender young woman with fair skin, neon blue hair that covers one eye, tropical indigo eyes, and pink cheeks. She wears a blue-and-white hoodie resembling a blue jay, khaki pants, fingerless gloves, and flip-flop sandals with socks. Despite being clumsy, accident-prone, and not very athletic, her arm gives her bursts of superhuman strength and quick reflexes, especially in games.

Tari is polite, often apologizing unnecessarily, and tends to avoid conflict—but when push comes to shove, her inner strength and skills shine through.

entries.name: Saiko Bitchitaru
entries.content:
Saiko Bichitaru is a hot-headed fighter and key member of the SMG4 Gang, known for her fiery personality and loyalty to her friends, especially Meggy and Tari. Originally brought to life by Fishy Boopkins in SMG4: Doki Doki Mario Club, Saiko began as a mentally unstable yandere villain but later chose to change her ways, becoming more compassionate—though she still has tsundere tendencies.

In the YouTube Arc, she was temporarily erased from existence after she and Whimpu accidentally altered her origin story. Thanks to Luigi’s advice in SMG4: Luigi’s Lesson, Saiko became more self-aware and began trying to atone for her past.

Saiko has a tall, curvy anime-style appearance, with pink hair in twin tails, purple and yellow highlights, purple eyes, and pinkish skin. She wears a tan jacket, black tube top, dark miniskirt, leggings, skull accessories, and red bows in her hair. Despite her sarcasm and aggressive edge, she genuinely cares for her friends and has come a long way from her destructive beginnings.

entries.name: Melony
entries.content:

entries.name: Bob Bobowski
entries.content:
Bob Bobowski is one of the three tritagonists of the SMG4 series, alongside Fishy Boopkins and SMG3. A lazy, idiotic Garo and member of SMG4’s Gang, Bob is best known for his trashy humor, selfish attitude, and chaotic behavior. Though he started off as arrogant and fame-hungry—especially during The Rapper Bob Arc, where he betrayed his friends to become a rap star—he eventually redeemed himself with help from Waluigi and rejoined the gang.

Despite his antics, Bob has become a lovable wildcard, often bringing comic relief to the group. In the Remastered64 series, he keeps his original Garo model for continuity, though his speech is now clearer and subtitled for easier understanding.

entries.name: Fishy Boopkins
entries.content:
Fishy Boopkins is one of the three tritagonists of the SMG4 series, alongside Bob Bobowski and SMG3. A goofy, cheerful sea creature and proud otaku, Boopkins is one of the last of his kind. He’s a huge anime fan (especially waifu pillows) and often tags along on adventures with the SMG4 Gang, especially his best friend Bob.

Although once a major character, Boopkins’ screen time decreased significantly starting in Season 11 due to a shift in focus to newer characters. He now appears mostly in ads and openings, but remains a fan-favorite for his light-hearted nature and quirky humor.

Boopkins has gone through several redesigns—from his original Spike-like look to a green, mohawk-wearing blob, and then to his current fishier form with gills, cyan fin hair, and geta sandals.

entries.name: Luigi
entries.content:
Luigi For Short) is one of the two deuteragonists (alongside Meggy Spletzer) of the SMG4 series.
He is a cowardly green-clad Italian plumber, Mario's fraternal twin brother/sidekick, a kinder citizen of the Mushroom Kingdom, and a loyal member of SMG4's Gang. He went on many adventures throughout the years and would often be there to handle Mario's shenanigans. Luigi is often a paranoid and easily scared man-child (mainly afraid of Boos), who is often humiliated by his peers. He was commonly treated as a joke of bully victim, being called gay and someone who "nobody cares about".
Despite the arguably cruel way he is normally treated, he is selfless and willing to commit for his friends. 
He wears a long-sleeved green shirt, blue overalls with yellow buttons, brown shoes, and gloves. He has a green cap, brown hair, a black moustache, and blue eyes. He is taller than his older brother Mario.

entries.name: Niles
entries.content: Niles, often mistaken as “SMG0” or “Zero,” was the main antagonist of the SMG4 Cosmology Lore Saga and the most dangerous villain in the series, capable of destroying the universe. Initially believed to be SMG0, it was revealed he had corrupted and assimilated his friend after being influenced by the God Box. This led to the creation of various eldritch forms, including those of SMG0, Axol, and Melony. Niles’ actions caused the deaths of several characters, including Fred, his own avatar. Unlike other Super Meme Guardians, Niles has a distinct, artificial look with gray skin, a red hat, and a hidden cyclopean eye. He is coolheaded, sarcastic, and rebellious, often targeting Melony for her innocence.

entries.name: Francis
entries.content: Francis was a major antagonist in SMG4 and the posthumous overarching villain of Sunset Paradise. As leader of the Anime Cartel, he began by smuggling anime goods and characters like Saiko into the Mushroom Kingdom. Betrayed by Axol and obsessed with power, he transformed the cartel into a terrorist group, captured Axol, and created Anime Island, using the stolen Inkweaver to fuel his twisted waifu-filled utopia. Though once influential and feared, Francis was revealed to be a power-hungry, delusional sociopath who murdered Desti and endangered Meggy and Inkopolis without remorse. Ultimately, he was shown to be a coward without the Inkweaver’s power and was killed by Saiko in revenge.

entries.name: Mr. Puzzles
entries.content: Mr. Puzzles is the current main antagonist of the SMG4 series, introduced in Season 13 and central to Season 14. Once a human, he became a cybernetic TV-headed being obsessed with creating perfect entertainment through his platform, Puzzlevision. Driven by childhood rejection and a craving for validation, he manipulated the SMG4 crew, turning their lives into chaotic “shows” to prove his creative superiority. His schemes caused massive upheaval, from destroying Peach’s Castle to taking over Didney Worl and creating Puzzle Park, where he brainwashed the crew. Despite a brief emotional connection with Meggy’s Leggy form, his obsessive, egotistical, and unstable nature led to his downfall. After his defeat and arrest, he was institutionalized, having lost his sanity entirely. While Meggy holds hope for his recovery, his future remains uncertain… FOR NOW.

entries.name: Leggy
entries.content: Leggy is a small, Goomba-like form of Meggy that appears in the SMG4 series, usually as a gag when Meggy is scared or for comedic effect. Occasionally able to speak, Leggy often communicates in squeaks and behaves childishly, similar to Mario. A whole species of Leggies appeared in the Meme Factory arc but mysteriously vanished afterward. In Season 14’s PUZZLEVISION Saga, Leggy briefly became a secondary antagonist after Mr. Puzzles forcibly reactivated the form to aid in his schemes. Meggy ultimately overcame the Leggy persona and claimed it was gone for good, though its sudden reappearance in Mario Gets Lost In A Shopping Mall leaves its fate uncertain.

entries.name: Boyfriend
entries.content:
Boyfriend is a recurring-turned-minor character in the SMG4 series and Sunset Paradise. He's the protagonist of the Newgrounds rhythm game Friday Night Funkin.
History
In SMG4: If Mario Was In.... Friday Night Funkin
He was facing off Daddy Dearest in a rap battle until Mario accidentally interrupts him, causing him to lose the battle. After he convinces Mario to help him get Girlfriend back, he tells Mario that the only way to save Girlfriend is to defeat Daddy Dearest, and begins training them. Once Mario was ready, he challenged Daddy Dearest and eventually wins. However, Dearest refused to lose, and summoned minions to defeat Mario. Mario retaliated by bringing in his own team (Luigi, Bob Bobowski, SMG4, and Chris & Swag), and through their help, he was able to defeat them. Daddy Dearest becomes powerless and Parappa the Rapper is freed from his body. Boyfriend and Girlfriend hug now that they were back together. They're about to kiss until Mario interrupts them, asking if they can now have the Spaghetti Lovers Club.
In If Friday Night Funkin Was 3D - ANIMATION
At some point, Boyfriend made a quick visit to Port Aurora to rap against the Funky Fource so that he could be with Girlfriend, suggesting that this happened before SMG4: If Mario Was In.... Friday Night Funkin. He teamed up with Meggy Spletzer to win.
In SMG4: If Mario Was In Friday Night Funkin 2
When Mommy Mearest cursed Mario and his friends to endless Friday Night Funk, Mario went to seek help from Boyfriend and the Girlfriend to help them beat Mommy's gang in a rap battle to break the curse.
In SMG4: The Other Universe
Boyfriend makes an appearance alongside many other Newgrounds characters in The ToyToy Kingdom. It was revealed that he was still a baby at that time. While helping everyone escape, SMG2 grabs Boyfriend to throw him in the back of his truck.
In SMG4: THE 5,000,000 SUB SPECIAL
He appears in a reimagine of If Mario Was In Friday Night Funkin where he sings Renai Circulation. In Mario's turn, he sings All I Want for Christmas is The DK Crew, causing Boyfriend's ears to burn as he attempts to cover them while screaming in agony.
In SMG4 Christmas Special 2021
He appears dancing with a Goomba in an Omnia Christmas Show.

entries.name: Freddy Fazbear
entries.content:
Freddy Fazbear is a recurring antagonist in the SMG4 series.
He is an animatronic bear who first appeared on the R****ded64 series, R64: Freddy's spaghettiria, where he mostly acted like he did in the Five Nights at Freddy's video game, but was ultimately defeated by Mario, who locked him in the security camera room, put on a scary face and gave the bear a taste of his own medicine. He is friends with Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and Golden Freddy.
He later burned with his other animatronic friends after Mario killed him when the power ran out.
He is a character from the first installment of the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise, serving as the titular main antagonist.
In the SMG4verse, Freddy makes various cameos and sometimes major, supporting ot minor roles but is prominently featured in the R****ded64 series, namely the Five Nights at Freddy's based episodes R64: Freddy's spaghettiria and R64: Return to Freddy's Spaghettria, where he is one of the main antagonists, alongside his friends, Bonnie the Bunny, Chica the Chicken, and Foxy the Pirate Fox. In Freddy's Spaghettiria, Mario takes Mike Schmidt's role as protagonist and security guard, but is only in it for free Spaghetti. Freddy and his friends attempted numerous times to kill Mario, but they all got defeated. Freddy was the last to die, since he was able to hide in the office.
In Return to Freddy's Spaghettiria, which is based on the second game, Mario is actually sucked into the game, and ends up in the second Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where he noticed that Freddy's condition has deteriorated, replaced with Toy Freddy. Despite this however, he will still try to go after Mario. However, this changed, when Mario told all of the withered animatronics to go after the toy animatronics and William Afton. Freddy was able to defeat his toy counterpart with a gun, but, like all the withered animatronics, they are defeated when William Afton disables them (but Chica survived).
His nightmare form serves a minor role in Ssenmodnar Deluxe during one of the skits, where he is chasing down Baby Mario. However, the baby had a gun, resulting in his death.
Later in SMG4: Freddy's Spaghetteria Security Breach, he appears as one of Vanny's kidnapped victims.

entries.name: Sans
entries.content:
Sans is a minor recurring character in the SMG4 series.
He is a skeleton and a recurring character in Undertale. He is also the brother of Papyrus who befriended Mario and became a Mii Gunner in the Super Smash Bros. community.
Sans is often seen to be laid back, lazy and often cracking up terrible puns much to his brother's annoyance, despite this, Sans will pull up a fight if anyone harms his brother or his dear friends.
Sans shows up in Snowdin along with his brother Papyrus. When Papyrus captures Mario (and falls in love with him) Sans leaves the house telling them "not to make too many babies", as a joke. After Mario destroys the police and the Giant dancing Papyrus robot, Sans shows up saying, "what monster could have done this?". He complains to Papyrus for letting the "human" escape. Mario faces Sans at the end where they have a big fight, like in the original Undertale. In the end, though, Mario pokes sans in his "sexy" eye, leaving him shaking on the ground in pain.
Since his debut, he has appeared in many ways as cameos as a joke.
In "Sans's First Day in Smash", he plays a big role in the episode. He appears along Mario, Link, Banjo & Kazooie on a smash stage, but he sits aside and sleeps while the others fight. Mario takes notice of this and confronts Sans on their last encounter. Sans reveals that he no longer holds any hostility towards the plumber and throws him off the stage as he follows behind, thus declaring Banjo the winner after killing Link. He appears in the lobby where he's sitting on the couch and has a slouching contest with Mario until they end up on the floor. Sans and Mario both decide to leave, until being confronted by Master Hand. Sans shows no signs of fear and endures all of his attacks until Papyrus arrives. There, he showcases his powers and defeats the manacle glove and drives off with his brother.
He again makes a return as a major character in "Steve Fights Everyone", acting as Master Hand's buddy for most of the episode as Steve fights many fighters. He eventually fights Steve himself but stops once he acknowledges his power. Master Hand, however, wants the two to kill each other. Once Mario, Steve and Sans band together, they defeat him once more.

entries.name: Slenderman
entries.content:
Slenderman, also known as Slendy, is a minor character in the SMG4 series.
He first appeared in Super Mario 64 Bloopers: My Best Friend Slenderman. He also appears in the opening video that automatically starts playing of oneself when you visit SMG4's channel. Unlike his traditional depictions as a horror icon and villain, Slendy is here portrayed as friendly, even having befriended Mario.
Slenderman is a Creepypasta Figure and appears to be friendly with Mario and SMG4. He stands 1 1/2 times Mario's height. Slenderman also shows his concern for Mario, as seen in SM64 Halloween 2016 - SPAGHETTI.EXE, saving him numerous times from the various Creepypastas. He has also made a Cameo appearance in multiple previous episodes.
Super Mario 64 Bloopers: My Best Friend Slenderman
On a dark night, Toad wants Mario to go to the shop. When coming to the gray, dark scission Mario passed in previous bloopers, Mario could either go via Gay Castle or a forest. Mario chose the forest. On a glade, Mario hears sinister sounds and a ghastly voice. He then spots Slenderman, unaware of who he is, and takes him to the castle. Everyone but Starman3 runs away from Mario. Starman tells Mario who Slenderman is but Mario doesn't believe him. When searching for a job for Slenderman in the borough, Starman3 and some constables appear. Starman3 declares Slenderman (or "Slendy", which is how Mario calls him) under arrest. Though, Slenderman uses the Slender-Copter, but crashes with Mario on Wario's parents as Starman3 watches from the high building Mario and Slender Man are. Later, in the castle, Slender Man keeled over and died because Toad forgot to feed him, making Mario sad before he's unceremoniously flushes Slendy's body down the toilet. While mourning his loss of his sexy suited friend, Toad expresses his apologies and tells Mario he bought him another pet Slenderman. Mario is right back to being excited only for the new Slenderman to up and die too, much to Mario's annoyance and chagrin.
SM64 Halloween 2016 - SPAGHETTI.EXE
The Episode is formatted in a game-esque mode, where the Game asks the Player, Frankie, if he dares to play. When the Game begins, Mario buys a Cursed Spaghetti Can from the Happy Mask Salesman. Mario then consumes the Can of Spaghetti, which causes him to perceive multiple Creepypastas such as Ben, Sonic.exe, Tails Doll, Jigsaw, Herobrine, Chucky, and Jeff the Killer respectively. Slenderman shows his soft side for Mario as he defends him against the Creepypastas. Later in the Episode, Mario gets an Exorcism done, and the Ben from earlier starts to copy himself all around inside the Building. Slenderman comes to the rescue again, saving Mario from the multiple Bens. However, when he escapes, Slenderman finds out that Mario has been turned into a Ben, initiating a Game Over.
SMG4 Halloween 2017: Trick Or Treat Wars
He helps Mario get/steal candy from kids.
SMG4: Lost In The Woods 
He helps Mario, Luigi, and SMG4 get out of the woods.
SMG4: Mario vs IT 🤡
"Slenderman" is seen playing a piano. Boopkins is freaked out by seeing him, while Mario is happy to see his friend again. Slenderman offers Mario a bro-fist, which Mario happily agrees with. However, this Slenderman is actually It in disguise, and he prepared to stab Mario as soon as he got close enough. Mario, however, revealed that he was bluffing, punched It, and explained that he knew that he wasn't the real Slenderman because "the real Slendy starts with their secret handshake".
SMG4: SSENMODNAR - 3,826,412 SUB SPECIAL
The real Slenderman is seen in the woods. Mario introduces Siren Head to him and leaves to take a piss. Unbeknownst to Mario, Slenderman and Siren Head secretly hate each other, causing them to get into a fight similar to Toy Story's Woody vs. Buzz Lightyear fight scene.
SMG4 Movie: 10 Year Anniversary Special
He makes a cameo in this movie, having a picnic with Ben.
SMG4: Mario Obliterates Minions
Mario calls him to defeat the rapper minion.

entries.name: Serial Designation N
entries.content:
Serial Designation N (mostly referred to as N) is the deuteragonist of the Glitch Productions web series Murder Drones, as well as a minor recurring character in SMG4. He is a kind-hearted Disassembly Drone with the attitude of wanting to get the job done, but he is oftentimes told by his co-workers that he is useless and terrible and barely gets respect.
N is a friendly Disassembly Drone who, like the rest of his kind, was originally a Worker Drone. He was recovered by Tessa to reside at Elliott Manor as a butler, where he met V, J and the Absolute Solver disguised as Cyn. Some time afterward, N and his fellow workers were rebuilt by the Solver into Disassembly Drones to help in destroying the Earth with suppressed memories and fabricated ones.
Copies of himself, V, and J respectively were deployed to Copper 9 to terminate all visible Workers seemingly for JCJenson, during which he had often been disrespected and treated badly by his teammates.
N is kind-hearted, nervous, and also socially awkward. He always wanted to make friends or at least get accepted and acknowledged by his co-workers, which is a very hard thing to do since he's terrible at doing his job due to his good-natured, unserious, and happy-go-lucky attitude that makes others look down on him and doubt that he can ever do something useful. This is what made him get treated as an outcast, his co-worker, and also unaware crush, Serial Designation V, never pays attention or takes any interest in him. His superior, Serial Designation J, often threatens and insults him about how worthless he is at doing his work and states that if the company one day allowed them to exterminate all the useless Murder Drones, she wouldn't hesitate to kill him.
Although, N disregards all their negative impressions and antagonizing acts and would forgive them. His crush on and loyalty to V results in him following Uzi to the colony, saying that the reason that he needs to kill her is because he cannot have Uzi shooting V with her railgun. He appears to be very trusting of people and maybe a bit naïve, as he assumed Uzi was his new squad mate despite her appearance, even wanting to introduce her to his squad, even though she would be immediately slaughtered.
But, despite being a friendly Murder Drone, N is shown to be dangerous when he is in a battle, having occasionally murderous moments, it is seen in the Pilot episode that N is highly intelligent, skilled in hunting down Worker Drones, and is very precise in targeting his enemies. Showing us that he only lacks confidence in communicating with others but is a professional killing machine like typical Murder Drones when it comes to attacking his targets.
N has features of a typical male Disassembly Drone, with a visor that shows his neon-yellow eyes and medium, fluffy silver hair parted to the left. Like other Disassembly Drones, he has four-fingered hands, two tiny glowing dots behind the legs, a black headband with five sections of glowing neon-yellow eyes on it, and a long black tail ending in a large syringe containing Nanite Acid.
He wears a short-sleeved black winter coat with a golden fur collar and a black belt, along with a black pilot hat with a white skull insignia. He also accessories a yellow armband that has a skull label on it on his left bicep. As shown from a few shots, he also has small fangs. The bottom of his feet and his wrists end in yellow and black hazard stripes.
When he is hunting, his mouth reveals several jagged teeth while his eyes become an "X" shape. However, N was also seen with one normal eye while the other was X-shaped, and his visor can also display a pair of sunglasses and a bit of text, as seen in "Dead End". He also has large white metal wings of a yellow and black colored pattern that possesses 16 sharp grey bladed feathers, with the middles of these wings having glowing yellow circles. He can also replace his hands and switched them out for weapons and things that can aid him in his tasks, one of which are three-sharp claws that allow him to tear through any drone and his victims.
